entries.title: What is NSDC?
entries.content: The National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) is a not-for-profit public limited company operating under the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE). It promotes vocational education, skill development, apprenticeships and employability through a public-private partnership model.

entries.title: NSDC's Mission
entries.content: NSDC is the strategic implementation and knowledge partner of the Skill India Mission. It supports futuristic skills, enterprises, start-ups and organizations through funding, concessional loans and skill ecosystem development.

entries.title: What is Skill India Digital?
entries.content: Skill India Digital (SID/SIDH) is the unified platform where learners register, complete e-KYC, discover courses, apply for training batches, access apprenticeships and manage their learner profile and certificates.

entries.title: Create a Skill India Digital Account
entries.content: Visit Skill India Digital, click Register, enter your mobile number, verify the OTP, create your account PIN, complete Aadhaar e-KYC and finish your learner profile. You can then browse schemes and apply for training programs.

entries.title: Complete Aadhaar e-KYC (OTP)
entries.content: During registration, enter your Aadhaar number, provide consent and verify the OTP sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number. Successful verification activates your learner profile.

entries.title: Complete Biometric e-KYC
entries.content: If your Aadhaar-linked mobile is unavailable, choose the Biometric option during e-KYC and authenticate using a supported fingerprint or iris device.

entries.title: Login to Skill India Digital
entries.content: Use your registered mobile number and the 4-digit account PIN created during registration to access your learner account.

entries.title: Forgot Account PIN
entries.content: Select Forgot Password, verify your registered mobile number using OTP and create a new 4-digit account PIN.

entries.title: Apply for a Training Batch
entries.content: After e-KYC, select the scheme, choose a job role, review available batches, verify the training centre and timings, select up to five batches and click Show Interest.

entries.title: Track Batch Application Status
entries.content: Applications move through Pending, Approved and Accepted stages. After the Training Centre approves your request, you must accept the invitation before enrollment is completed.

entries.title: Job Role Not Visible
entries.content: Reload the portal, select the correct scheme and sector, then browse View All Job Roles. Verify the Training Centre, Partner and batch timings before applying.

entries.title: Find Skill Courses
entries.content: Search courses using sector, job role, location, training provider or government scheme. Skill India Digital supports discovery across multiple industry sectors.

entries.title: Available Course Sectors
entries.content: Courses are available across IT, Healthcare, Electronics, Retail, Tourism, Agriculture, Automotive, Logistics and several other industry domains.

entries.title: My Dashboard
entries.content: The learner dashboard lets you manage your profile, applications, enrolled batches, certificates and learning progress from one place.

entries.title: Digital Certificates
entries.content: Eligible learners receive digital certificates after successfully completing approved training and assessment. Certificate availability depends on the specific program.

entries.title: Employer Services
entries.content: Employers can discover skilled candidates, participate in apprenticeship and hiring initiatives, and engage with Skill India talent through the NSDC ecosystem.

entries.title: Training Partners & Institutions
entries.content: Training Partners can manage centres, create courses, create batches, enroll candidates, record attendance and support assessments through the NSDC ecosystem.

entries.title: Technical Support
entries.content: If you experience registration, login, e-KYC, certificate or batch issues, submit a support ticket with your registered details and issue description through the official NSDC Support Portal.

entries.title: Student Helpline
entries.content: The verified NSDC Student Helpline number is 8800055555. Training Partners have a separate helpline at 9289200333.

entries.title: What is Apprenticeship Training?
entries.content: Apprenticeship training combines basic training with structured on-the-job practical training under a formal apprenticeship contract in an industry or establishment.

entries.title: Which sectors support Apprenticeships?
entries.content: Apprenticeship programs are available across both manufacturing and service sectors in India.

entries.title: NSDC Academy Course Formats
entries.content: NSDC Academy offers learning in online, offline and hybrid formats depending on the course and training provider.
